name: Anti-revisionism
summary: Anti-revisionism is the Marxist-Leninist current that arose in the mid-1950s against Khrushchev's reforms and kept Stalin's legacy. It holds that revolution, a vanguard party and a continuing dictatorship of the proletariat are indispensable, that class struggle persists under socialism, and that the post-Stalin Soviet leadership restored capitalism, calling it state-capitalist and social-imperialist.
scope: Anti-revisionism as the Encyclopedia of Anti-Revisionism On-Line defines it: the trend in the pro-Soviet (non-Trotskyist) communist movement that criticised the official Communist Parties 'from the left' for abandoning orthodox Marxism-Leninism, defended Stalin once they joined Khrushchev's denunciation of him, and later expanded to those aligned with Chinese or Albanian positions. Its texts are the CPC's polemics on the general line (1963-64) and Hoxha's Imperialism and the Revolution. Where the Chinese and Albanian poles split (three worlds theory, the view of China) the answers are marked low or neutral. It excludes Trotskyist critiques of revisionism and the post-Mao Chinese line.

production-for-use.rationale: Nulled (later pass, 2026-11-25): the answer rested on a source the defining sources do not tie to the ideology, and the three kept texts state no position on this statement.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Hoxha says capital extracts surplus value from workers and that the Soviet new bourgeoisie appropriates it too.

promote-ethnic-return-migration.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

property-franchise.rationale: The General Line makes the working people the ruling class and condemns bourgeois privilege, so a property franchise is opposed.

property-fundamental.rationale: Hoxha treats private ownership of monopolies and means of production as the basis of exploitation, to be overthrown, not protected.

property-sabotage-justified.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Nulled (later pass, 2026-11-25): the answer rested on a source the defining sources do not tie to the ideology, and the three kept texts state no position on this statement.

proportional-representation.rationale: The CPC letter rejects parliamentary cretinism; electoral formula is a minor issue for them.

public-ownership.rationale: Ownership by the whole people and collective ownership are the two socialist forms the CPC letter defends, and they hold that the Soviet state under revisionism betrayed them.

publish-international-agreements.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

race-based-immigration-restrictions.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

racial-community-economic-control.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

racial-franchise.rationale: Proletarian internationalism opposes ethnic or racial limits on political rights.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Politics is organised by class and proletarian internationalism, not race.

racial-oppression-before-sexism.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Anti-colonial and anti-racist liberation is central to their line. The sources set out the underlying principle but do not state a position on this specific statement.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Hoxha opposes religious and mystical ideas; scientific materialism is basic to their view. 'Only' guide is a strong wording.

recognize-territorial-claims-from-conque.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

refuse-to-join-illegitimate-government.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

regional-resource-ownership.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Hoxha says the state is subordinate to monopolies, so regulation is a reformist illusion, yet adherents would not oppose curbs on capital; genuinely mixed.

religion-from-peoples-character.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

religion-illusion.rationale: Nulled (later pass, 2026-11-25): the answer rested on a source the defining sources do not tie to the ideology, and the three kept texts state no position on this statement.

religious-nation.rationale: Hoxha treats religion as reactionary and opposes it, so a religious definition of the nation is rejected.

religious-offensive-war.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

remove-indigenous-peoples.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

remove-other-ethnic-groups-from-country.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

replace-appointed-officials.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

reserved-seats-excluded-groups.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

resist-oppression-despite-death.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

restore-past-order.rationale: Nulled (later pass, 2026-11-25): the answer rested on a source the defining sources do not tie to the ideology, and the three kept texts state no position on this statement.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: They attack reformist union leaders but would not restrict workers' strike action under capitalism.

restrict-technology-exports-to-rivals.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Hoxha attacks imperialist and neo-colonial exploitation of developing countries and backs their struggles.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Nulled (later pass, 2026-11-25): the answer rested on a source the defining sources do not tie to the ideology, and the three kept texts state no position on this statement.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Nulled (later pass, 2026-11-25): the answer rested on a source the defining sources do not tie to the ideology, and the three kept texts state no position on this statement.

return-to-pre-conversion-religion.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

revolution-legitimate.rationale: The CPC letter (point 9) calls for mastering all forms of struggle, armed struggle included, and says the proletarian party must lead revolution when conditions are ripe; Hoxha's ch. 3 argues the same.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Hoxha says capitalist aid is meant to extract profit and control; real help is between socialist states.

rule-by-example.rationale: They stress class power and party discipline; moral example alone is not their view.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Hoxha stresses repression sharpening alongside class struggle.

sacred-nation.rationale: Hoxha treats bourgeois nationalism as an enemy and puts proletarian internationalism first, though he supports patriotism of the working class.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Materialist hostility to religion and monarchy. The sources set out the underlying principle but do not state a position on this specific statement.

say-in-proportion-to-effect.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

school-vouchers.rationale: Privatised education funding conflicts with socialist state education.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: Marxist-Leninist materialism and Hoxha's anti-religious campaigns reject scripture as literal divine truth.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Nulled (later pass, 2026-11-25): the answer rested on a source the defining sources do not tie to the ideology, and the three kept texts state no position on this statement.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Hoxha says genuine socialist states should reject capitalist credits and rely on their own forces.

separate-church-state.rationale: Anti-revisionist Albania separated church and state radically, and Hoxha attacks religious ideas as reactionary.

separated-powers.rationale: Democratic centralism and party leadership are opposed to checks and balances between bodies.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-11): its rationale is about teaching gender equality, and the statement now asks only about sex education.

shared-state-rival-peoples.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

shut-down-tax-havens.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

simple-living.rationale: Hoxha's Imperialism and the Revolution stresses self-reliance and austerity as socialist virtues.

single-common-good.rationale: They hold that class interests oppose each other, so politics is class struggle.

slavery-reparations.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

small-step-social-reform.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

smash-state-machine.rationale: The General Line insists the proletariat must smash the old bourgeois state machine rather than take it over.

social-market-economy.rationale: Nulled (later pass, 2026-11-25): the answer rested on a source the defining sources do not tie to the ideology, and the three kept texts state no position on this statement.

socialism-needs-revolutionary-war.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Nulled (later pass, 2026-11-25): the answer rested on a source the defining sources do not tie to the ideology, and the three kept texts state no position on this statement.

socialism-one-country.rationale: Hoxha holds the revolution triumphs in each country individually and defends Stalin, who built socialism in one country.

socialized-markets.rationale: Hoxha attacks Yugoslav self-management as capitalist, and Ninth Comment condemns profit and material incentives, so market socialism is revisionism.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: The CPC letter treats law as class-based; a ruler above law is feudal. The sources set out the underlying principle but do not state a position on this specific statement.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: Hoxha says Western credits serve profit and control, not development.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Hoxha's ch. 2 holds that capitalism was restored in the Soviet Union, ruled by a bureaucratic and technocratic stratum that appropriates surplus value, but his text speaks of a capitalist country, not of state capitalism by name.

spiritual-nature.rationale: The sources hold to dialectical materialism and treat religion as an obstacle to be fought.

state-as-business.rationale: Nulled (later pass, 2026-11-25): the answer rested on a source the defining sources do not tie to the ideology, and the three kept texts state no position on this statement.

state-class-instrument.rationale: The CPC letter says any state has a class character, and Hoxha calls the state instrument of the monopolies.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Nulled (later pass, 2026-11-25): the answer rested on a source the defining sources do not tie to the ideology, and the three kept texts state no position on this statement.

state-finances-worker-businesses.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

state-harmful.rationale: The CPC letter says the state and dictatorship of the proletariat must persist through the whole transition, rejecting any view of the state as simply harmful.

state-laws-apply-online.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Hoxha's Albania declared itself an atheist state in 1967 and its 1976 constitution (Art. 37) committed the state to atheist propaganda; Mao-era China also ran anti-religious campaigns through schools. The Hoxha texts cited treat religion as reactionary.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: The CPC letter says the dictatorship of the proletariat must be strengthened and not abolished, and rejects withering away claims.

state-supports-good-ways-of-life.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Hoxha condemned both the US and the Soviet Union as imperialist superpowers, and Albania left the Warsaw Pact.

students-direct-own-learning.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Anti-revisionist states curbed religious institutions, and Hoxha attacks religious ideas.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Nulled (later pass, 2026-11-25): the answer rested on a source the defining sources do not tie to the ideology, and the three kept texts state no position on this statement.

tax-holding-cash.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Hostile to inherited wealth as a basis of class privilege; no direct source on taxation.

taxation-theft.rationale: The state is the proletariat's instrument for building socialism, and levies are legitimate.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: They hold that only changing class relations solves social problems, though they favour industrial progress.

technology-design-reflects-political-int.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Hoxha condemns expansion and interference as imperialist and colonialist.

torture-always-illegal.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: They reject the equation of communism with fascism and defend Stalin's record against anti-communist condemnation.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: They reject trade agreements as reformist tools of imperialism.

troops-home-from-abroad.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

turn-back-illegal-migrants.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

unbroken-national-continuity.rationale: Adherents defend national independence, but the Maoist and Hoxhaist cores read history through class struggle; the sources do not take a position on ancient continuity.

unions-good.rationale: Unions are accepted as working-class organisations, yet Hoxha casts reformist trade-union leaders as agents of the labor aristocracy.

unions-run-economy.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

unpaid-domestic-work-exploitation.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

vanguard-party.rationale: Hoxha argues the proletariat needs its own vanguard party to lead the masses and win state power.

voluntary-union-payments-at-work.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

vote-at-sixteen.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

wages-fall-to-bare-minimum.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

war-builds-character.rationale: They distinguish just liberation wars from predatory imperialist wars, and do not celebrate war as character-building.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Internationalism cuts against nativist welfare, but they do not address it.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Nulled (later pass, 2026-11-25): the answer rested on a source the defining sources do not tie to the ideology, and the three kept texts state no position on this statement.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Revolutionary commitment and party membership are duties in their doctrine, so withdrawal is rejected. The sources set out the underlying principle but do not state a position on this specific statement.

women-organise-apart-from-men.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

women-suffrage.rationale: Nulled (later pass, 2026-11-25): the answer rested on a source the defining sources do not tie to the ideology, and the three kept texts state no position on this statement.

work-centre-of-life.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

worker-farmer-alliance.rationale: The CPC letter tells the proletariat to unite with the peasants in a solid worker-peasant alliance and calls for consolidating that alliance under socialism.

worker-ownership.rationale: Hoxha attacks Yugoslav self-administration as a capitalist system; ownership by workers firm by firm differs from ownership by the whole people or collectives.

workers-anti-imperialist-capitalist-alli.rationale: The CPC letter (point 9) says the proletarian party must make a full appraisal of the progressive role of the patriotic national bourgeoisie in newly independent countries and strengthen unity with it.

workers-councils.rationale: Soviet-type councils are part of Leninist heritage, but the sources stress party leadership rather than councils as the basis of power.

workers-nation.rationale: Proletarian internationalism is core to them; Hoxha condemns the nationalist stance as incompatible with it.

workers-own-party.rationale: The CPC letter insists on a vanguard Marxist-Leninist party of the working class, independent of bourgeois and revisionist parties.

workers-parties-campaign-reforms.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Hoxha rejects Yugoslav self-administration as a model; democratic control is exercised through the party and state.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Hoxha describes monopolies exporting capital, dividing markets and extracting profit.

youth-equal-civil-rights.rationale: None of the defining sources or key works states a position on this.

missingStatements.text: A communist party can win socialism through a parliamentary majority without breaking the existing state apparatus.
missingStatements.rationale: The CPC letter says no historical precedent exists for peaceful transition and warns against parliamentary cretinism, and Hoxha calls the parliamentary road revisionist.

missingStatements.text: Coexistence between states of different social systems should take priority over supporting revolutionary movements abroad.
missingStatements.rationale: The CPC letter holds that peaceful coexistence cannot replace the revolutionary struggles of the peoples, the central charge against Khrushchev.
missingStatements.declined: Coexistence versus backing foreign revolutions is specific to the Sino-Soviet split; party-own-road and revolution-legitimate cover the core of it.

notes: Maoist and Hoxhaist strands disagree over the three worlds theory, the Cultural Revolution and the judgement of China; the profile follows what both share. Many answers on cultural and social questions are inferred from Stalin-line practice rather than stated in the opened sources, hence low confidence. Later pass (2026-11-25): the Ninth Comment (old s3) and Wikipedia (old s1) are no longer cited because the defining sources do not tie the Ninth Comment to anti-revisionism; answers that rested only on them are nulled or re-grounded in s2, s4 and s5. Themes searched in those three texts: economy, government, world, means, society, culture.
